items.source_en:
I spoke to Commander Natara on SY-920. She assured me that the change in leadership won't affect the rollout of Project Svalinn, and any future visits won't be hindered by the new security measures she put in place.

There was one odd thing. When I asked her about the previous Commander, she gave me a really bizarre non-answer, which was very out of character. Given how much smoother things have gone under her command, I figured it'd be best not to press the issue. If she wants to sidestep the topic, that's up to her, as long as we get what we need.
items.legacy_ko:
SY-920의 나타라 사령관과 이야기를 나눴다. 그분은 지휘관이 변했다고 해서 스발린 프로젝트의 배치에 영향을 있지는 않을 것이며, 앞으로의 방문에도 나타라 지휘관께서 시행한 새로운 보안 조치로 인해 방해받지 않을 것이라고 보장하셨다.
